summary: Frontend-only regression of the 'Caro' -> 'Kharo' rebrand and the 24-item copy/design pass. Verified rebrand, honest stats, budget slider, listings per city, vehicle detail, apply flow, footer socials, help/legal copy and Quotezone referral links. 11 of 12 requested checks pass cleanly; 1 minor concern about polluted operator-count on /list-your-fleet.

minor.issue: Returns operators:34 but recent_operators list shows several TEST_ prefixed entries (e.g. TEST_OpCo_9212ab, TEST_Fleet_de32da, TEST_Op_0475e0, TEST_Fleet_0e8aca) plus placeholder rows like 'abc' polluting the real count. Frontend then renders '34 operators have already registered their interest' on /list-your-fleet. Frontend logic is correct (falls back to 'Be one of the first operators to join Kharo' only when count==0), so the fix is data-side: purge TEST_ / junk operator_interest rows so the visible number is honest.
